blind.description: A tight cluster of four small fantasy potion bottles or alchemy vials resting directly on the ground. The group includes a taller reddish-brown bottle with a rounded stopper, a round green bottle with a cork, a warm yellow-orange bottle with a cork, and a small round magenta-purple bottle with a cork. All surfaces are smooth, continuous, and solid with matte ceramic or colored glass finishes. There are no detached floating parts or added bases.
blind.from_above: A compact two-by-two cluster of four small round bottle necks and cork stoppers in green, reddish-brown, purple, and orange.
blind.height_vs_figure: Around 8 to 10 inches tall, approximately one-seventh the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure, and about 8 inches wide across the cluster.
